snippet.title: Clive Barker’s Hellraiser: Revival - Gameplay Overview Trailer
snippet.description:
Play the demo on Steam: https://sabr.gg/HellraiserSteamDemo 

Crafting a Labyrinth is never a small feat.

Witness twisted desires made flesh, the bloody battles and abilities the box so generously grants you.


The combat is brutal and visceral. With a wide variety of weapons at your disposal, from hard-hitting melee weapons to explosive firearms, you'll have plenty of ways to banish Hell's minions. You'll need to keep your wits about you, dodging attacks, scavenging for ammo and healing, laying down traps, and bartering for upgrades to stay alive against Cultists, Runners, Bursters, the Unworthy and other terrors.
That's where the Genesis Configuration comes in. Wield the supernatural powers of this mysterious puzzle box to hurl objects against enemies, scorch them with fire and much more. Use the might at your fingertips to bring the pain to your enemies, gather their Suffering, and even you can unleash the ultimate destruction… the infamous Hell Chains!


Wishlist or pre-order now!
🖤 Steam: https://sabr.gg/HellraiserSteam 
💙 PlayStation 5: https://sabr.gg/HellraiserPlayStation 
💚 Xbox Series X|S: https://sabr.gg/HellraiserXbox 
❤️Nintendo Switch 2: https://sabr.gg/Nintendo
